title: Two-Phase totalWithdrawal Includes Deposits Made During Waiting Period
rootCause: Phase 1 of totalWithdrawal caches state.balance from this.balanceOf() (principal). But _totalWithdraw() ignores the amount parameter entirely and reads live clientBalances[token][client] to calculate proportional shares. Any deposits made by authorized clients during the 24-hour waiting period are silently included in the Phase 2 withdrawal.
impact: The two-phase timelock exists to give the community time to react to withdrawal announcements. This bypass undermines that protection — the owner can initiate Phase 1, have the client deposit more during the waiting period, and Phase 2 withdraws everything including the new deposits.
recommendation: Either (a) make _totalWithdraw use the cached amount parameter, or (b) freeze deposits for the client during an active withdrawal state.
